answer: Require a voyage of paid work: each identity builds standing only from completed jobs that distinct, established clients sign and pay for, gathering nectar job by job, not all at once. A client attests delivery and payment on the ledger, and one who vouches for fake work risks its own standing, so rings of fake clients collapse under shale-like layers of empty receipts. An attacker must either do real work for every fake or bribe many real clients, so cost grows with each identity. Limit: honest newcomers start with no history, and a rich attacker can buy real jobs.
